status: Locally fixed before step-4 formal runs; follows inspected earlier results; not externally preregistered.
scope: Independent reconstruction and interval separation audit of nominal scheduled trajectories; quantify resource conservatism without changing the current model or optimizing parameters after seeing results.

geometry.domain: From entry at initial airborne layer through final route endpoint, including all segment boundaries; no physical takeoff, landing, acceleration or uncertainty
geometry.independent_reconstruction: Read scenario CSV, network/type JSON and selected route/layer/lane/speed/delay; no scheduler position, segment-builder or sampled-validator call in the independent module
geometry.predicate: Loss when horizontal distance < larger type horizontal threshold AND vertical distance < larger type vertical threshold
geometry.method: Split flight pairs at segment boundaries; exact quadratic horizontal minimum for affine motion, analytic derivative/Lipschitz lower bounds for curved motion; adaptive subdivision; vertical extrema from affine height
geometry.classification: Separated / violation with time witness / unresolved. Unresolved never counted safe. Analytical bounds evaluated in float64 with an explicit guard, not a directed-rounding formal arithmetic proof.

network_sensitivity.buffer_change: Change node before/after and vertical buffers together; hold edge trailing 2 s, geometry, thresholds, speed, objective and scheduler fixed
network_sensitivity.paired_requests: Multiply each original requested time by the integer scale, retaining exact IDs, priorities, types and routes; original 60 s window becomes 60/300/900/1800 s; same integer 2 s added-delay grid
network_sensitivity.baseline_reuse: Buffer=8 and request_scale=1 uses unchanged 30 archived WSR records, shared by the two one-factor sweeps
network_sensitivity.report: Completion, weighted/total delay, makespan, finite-batch clearance rate, actual bottleneck occupancy, and independent nominal continuous-interval separation status. No new p-values, no unsafe result presented as deployable capacity, no tuning of final_protocol.json.

isolated_edge.headways: On a 2 s grid: whole-edge max(T+2,2b); homogeneous straight-lane following max(R/v,2b). Both retain the same entry/exit node spacing; buffers >=4 s avoid threshold-equality ambiguity.
isolated_edge.interpretation: Periodic single-lane homogeneous packing benchmark under deterministic prescribed speed, not network capacity, a new deployed scheduler, heterogeneous catch-up or merge feasibility. Every finite benchmark independently separation-audited.

adversarial_tests: Between-sample crossing, closed endpoints, vertical transition, curved trajectories, near-threshold unresolved status, disjoint-resource geometric crossing, and geometrically safe following rejected by full-edge reservation. Include independent-reconstruction cross-check against existing trajectory definitions only in tests.
timing: Formal schedule-generation sweeps sequential. Wall times descriptive, not a new algorithm runtime comparison; audit and figure work may run concurrently only after timed generation finishes.
